0022600019.text: The Raptors (3-1, 2-0 at home, riding a one-game win streak) host the Orlando Magic (1-3, 0-2 at home, on a one-game losing streak) in the Raptors' fifth game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup. Toronto is third in the East and 0.5 games back in the Atlantic, while Orlando is 10th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Southeast, with Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) out for Toronto, and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain) out for Orlando. The Raptors lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 129-99 win in Toronto on October 28, and they also won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
